designationHistory.indexText: The Fish and Wildlife Service approved and established the Neches River National Wildlife Refuge along the upper Neches River in Anderson and Cherokee Counties, Texas, in 2006.

authority.citation: Administrative establishment by the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (approval of the refuge and acquisition boundary)

designationHistory.note: FWS gives June 11, 2006. The City of Dallas and the State of Texas sued over the refuge, which delayed it; KETR reports the courts upheld its creation in 2010.
